title: How to Box in HD - The Right Cross/Straight Right
method: Normal public IAB player, paused screenshots and bounded single-frame stepping. UIseek115.392 and144.24 first readyState1 screenshots excluded; same times later independently observed readyState4.

observations.observed: Presenter gestures at waist while demonstrating body rotation from staggered feet; no learner alignment measurement.

Guard maintained during body-only rotation demonstration.127.192 shows rear heel visibly raised and rear knee/body changing orientation; motion blur limits exact joint tracking. No fixed pivot angle or load inferred.
Both hands near guard before strike, staggered feet.
Rear arm moves into extension with body rotation and rear heel raised; motion blur means endpoint not used as precise elbow/wrist model.
Hand returning near face while rear heel still raised.
Both hands near guard with rear foot returned closer to starting orientation.

supportedFamilies: heel-knee-hip movement occurs together rather than twisting torso over rigidly fixed flat foot
small original separate hand-path preparation may be contrasted with source full sport action
adaptation: Source explicitly teaches explosive drive and large power rotation. JabLab does not adopt that thrust, power target, fixed clock-angle, contact, forward lunge or knee loading. Original very short slow empty-space hand path/feet-down or hand/paper explanation remains; if heel-knee-hip relationship is uncertain do not add a pivot and stop that physical attempt.
notEstablished: universal feet or heel rule across arts
